description: Reference spec for Merrimack workflow output validation. Provide MERRIMACK_REFERENCE_OUTPUT_DIR pointing at a completed run, or MERRIMACK_REFERENCE_FINAL_RASTER for a direct raster path. Override with MERRIMACK_REFERENCE_SPEC_JSON to use a different spec file. Tight bounds use authoritative sounding coordinates; loose bounds are sanity checks.

checks.name: estuary_channel_deep
checks.note: Main estuary channel near mouth — should be negative (below datum). A positive value here means sign flip or depth cap regression.

checks.name: estuary_channel_mid
checks.note: Mid-estuary channel — expects submerged bed elevation.

checks.name: nearshore_shallow
checks.note: Nearshore shallow zone — should be close to datum. Catches cases where deep predictions bleed into shallows.

checks.name: upstream_river_bed
checks.note: Upstream river bed — positive NAVD88 allowed for elevated rivers. Should NOT be deeper than -5m at this location.

checks.name: upstream_inland
checks.note: Inland reach — expects shallow river channel or positive bed.

checks.name: sign_consistency_estuary
checks.note: Estuary must have negative (submerged) bed elevation. Positive value = sign convention failure.

sign_checks.name: estuary_below_datum
sign_checks.note: All estuary channel points must have negative (submerged) bed elevation in NAVD88.

monotonicity_checks.name: channel_deepens_downstream
monotonicity_checks.note: Estuary channel should generally deepen toward the ocean (downstream elevation < upstream elevation).
